title: A file whose field stamp is newer than meta.updatedAt is clamped and can lose a tie; confirm no real writer (web, engine, CLI, hosted MCP) can produce one
evidence: No writer produces one. Each real write runs with its clock an hour ahead of and behind the record, and its raw bytes are walked for any updatedAt past meta.updatedAt (stamp-anchor.test-helpers.ts): health-core edits, erase, merge, migrate and the MCP tools over FileAdapter and Dropbox (record-writers-stamp-anchor.test.ts); the CLI (tools/edit-record-stamp-anchor.test.ts); every RoadmapStore write and device copy (roadmap-store-stamp-anchor.test.ts); every engine Edit kind, erase and merge door (ios/engine/stamp-anchor.test.ts) and the cloud doors (ios/engine/cloud.test.ts). Found by PR 1587's test helper, which wrote a profile stamp 1 s ahead; migrate.ts sanitizeStamp clamps it
durability_check: stamp-anchor tests in health-core, widget-src, tools and ios/engine; the engine table is typed by Edit kind, so a new kind fails typecheck:engine
